hebrewText: וַ/אֲנִ֤י כְּ/זַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּ/בֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְ/חֶֽסֶד אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָ/עֶֽד

tokens.kjv: I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

tokens.bdb: an olive (as yielding illuminating oil), the tree, the branch or the berry
verdant; by analogy, new; figuratively, prosperous
a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)

tokens.bdb: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
